name: Timbó (Brazil)
description: Gyronny of eight of light blue and white, charged at the centre with a white rectangle bearing the municipal arms with the motto CLARA EX STIRPE.
history: Timbó is a municipality in the state of Santa Catarina, Brazil. The flag was adopted on 4 July 1969 (prescribed by Municipal Law No. 477 of 4 July 1969, the arms by Law No. 77 of 22 August 1950, according to Flags of the World).

features.role: gyronny of eight of light blue and white
central rectangle bearing the municipal arms
municipal arms with a mural crown, a shield with crossed tools and a landscape, between branches, with the motto CLARA EX STIRPE and the name MUNICÍPIO DE TIMBÓ
